analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($94,225) vs SMA5 ($90,622)/SMA20 ($96,811)/SMA50 ($103,804): above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/SMA50.
· Below SMA100 ($111,546)/SMA200 ($100,695): mid-to-long term trend is weak.
· 52-week position (40.8%): risen from historical lows but in a downtrend from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.4→45.4): exiting oversold and now sideways in the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1879.8924→273.9848): shifting from bearish to improving, potential for bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $96,811): sideways near the middle band, bandwidth at 39.09% indicating continued volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($85,670): based on 52-week low and Pivot S1 ($80,775).
· Swing resistance ($95,680): approaching 5-day high ($97,285) and Pivot PP ($96,860).
· 5-day high ($97,285) < 20-day high ($112,945): Lower High pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.53x): increased compared to the 5-day average, slightly boosting confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI neutral, MACD improving, Lower High pattern suggests directional uncertainty. Maintain wait-and-see stance.
